query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',c.id,'title',c.title,'state',c.state,'revision',c.revision,'coverage',CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assistant_conversation_sources s WHERE s.workspace_id=c.workspace_id AND s.conversation_id=c.id AND s.state='partial') THEN 'partial' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assistant_conversation_sources s WHERE s.workspace_id=c.workspace_id AND s.conversation_id=c.id AND s.state='provisional') THEN 'provisional' ELSE 'complete' END,'last_activity_at',c.last_activity_at,'expires_at',c.expires_at) AS "data!" FROM assistant_conversations c WHERE c.workspace_id=$1 AND c.user_id=$2 AND c.id=$3 AND c.state<>'deleted' AND c.expires_at>now()
